concept.title: Where to find an English bookshop in Paris?
concept.shortdesc: If you're in Paris wondering where to find your next read, you're in the right place! Whether you're an anglophone tourist visiting Paris or a local willing to learn English, you'll find everything you need in this guide.

p.b: Here is an extensive list of Anglophone bookshops in Paris:

li.p: Smith and Son (main shop): 248, 250 Rue de Rivoli 75001
Shakespeare and Company: 37 Rue de la Bûcherie 75005
The Abbey Bookshop: 29 Rue de la Parcheminerie 75005
San Francisco Book Co: 17 Rue Monsieur le Prince 75006
The Red Wheelbarrow Bookstore: 9, 11 Rue de Médicis 75006

p.b: Here are some honorable mentions if you can't find what your looking for:

section.note: These bookshops specialize in more than just the sale of English-language books.

li.p: Taschen: Coffee table books. 2 Rue de Buci 75006
Brentano: Books, stationery, souvenirs and decorations. 37 avenue de l'Opéra 75002
SMDBOOKS: Lovely little bookshop with a selection of French, Spanish and English books. 1 Rue Nicolas Roret 75013
Bouquinerie Oxfam: Second hand books, CDs and DVDs (mostly french but a nice selection of English books). 61 Rue Daguerre 75014
The American library: Not a bookshop but a library, if you want to be ecologically responsible. 10 Rue Général Camou
Bookoff:Second hand books in various languages (mostly French and Japanese).
Gibert Joseph:New and second hand books in various languages.
Cultura:Mostly French books but also a selection of popular English books.
Fnac:Mostly French books but also a selection of popular English books.
